title: Languages on The O2 stage triple in eight years
summary: The number of languages represented across performances at London’s The O2 has tripled since 2018 as the demand for global artists explodes. The 20,000-capacity venue is experiencing its most linguistically diverse year yet in 2026, with 18 languages represented across the year — a nearly 30% boost since 2024 alone and 200% from 2018. Languages range from Spanish, Catalan, and French to Korean and Japanese, as well as African ones of Yoruba and Lingala. title: Australian festivals rally to all-time high $400m revenue and attendance in 2025
summary: Despite the Australian festival scene often painted in crisis, the contemporary music festival sector achieved its highest revenue and attendance levels in 2025, hitting nearly A$400 million (€250.3m) and drawing over 2 million people.
